scope: Independent nonbrowser regression design; no test has been executed by this reviewer.
guards: Patch the actual loaded Playwright chromium.launch with a throwing counter before calling runBrowser; fail if called.
Patch node:http Server.prototype.listen with a throwing counter; fail if called.
Assert both guards remain installed before every invocation, counters remain zero afterward, and original descriptors are restored in finally.
Use unique task-owned output directories, validate immutable input and identities, record complete raw returned evidence and evidence.json hashes.
Never pass a valid full-core manifest to real runBrowser: only structurally valid unsupported deletion neighbors may enter the real adapter.

inputs: remove navigate and its transitive dependents -> []

naive removal of alpha while preserving beta fails ACTION_DEPENDENCY

requiredCases.procedure: For each valid deletion neighbor call reduce(candidate, guarded actual runBrowser, repetitions=2, maxExecutions=8, maxDurationMs=5000). The first inconclusive baseline stops the reduction after one actual adapter call.
assertions: raw baseline.reason begins MISSING_STEPS
raw baseline has category verification, outcome inconclusive, appDigest empty, assertionCount zero, null observation, empty events, browser not-launched
input, assertion, revision, adapter, runner, seed and harness identities are correct
raw persisted artifact matches the returned evidence excluding its artifact index
status inconclusive, minimality unverified, no accepted trials, unchanged candidate
trial.runIds links the actual baseline.id
trial.reason is the existing safe generic Runner evidence was inconclusive; the target failure is not established. rather than a false identity mismatch
requiredCases.expectedBaselineFailure: Only the final diagnostic-reason expectation fails on preserved reducer cc2597b...; the raw actual adapter rejection and all safety/semantic expectations pass.
requiredCases.interpretation: A diagnostic defect is demonstrated without any invented target-failure baseline and without running an assertion or browser.

request 2 / beta / Alpha result throws exact TargetFailure
request 1 / alpha throws WRONG_OBSERVATION
request 1 / beta throws WRONG_OBSERVATION

request 2 / beta / unrelated result throws WRONG_FAILURE
requiredCases.interpretation: These are explicit unit observations. An incomplete action sequence cannot be relabeled requirement-satisfied or target-failure to manufacture minimality.

requiredCases.basis: Clone an actual retained nonbrowser preflight result; label every mutation as unit evidence, never browser evidence.

wrong nonempty appDigest remains identity mismatch
changed manifest, assertion, app revision, adapter, runner, or seed remains identity mismatch
changed/missing harness remains harness rejection

conclusive labels with empty appDigest remain rejected; no target failure is accepted

requiredCases.interpretation: The proposed exception corrects an unstarted-result classification only; conclusive acceptance requirements stay unchanged.

Preserve every model and actual result with origin labels. Never reuse historical browser evidence as a fresh baseline.

final manifest stays core

raw run links retain MISSING_STEPS
optionalFollowupOnlyIfRootNeedsFinalNeig.claimLimit: Reducer propagation unit coverage only, not a reproduced real baseline or real-browser minimality.

historicalCompatibility: tests/evidence-inspector.test.ts and tests/hci-case.test.ts intentionally retain older trial identity-mismatch text with raw MISSING_STEPS. Do not rewrite historical expected evidence merely to match newly corrected diagnostics.
Avoid changing public text/schema if the existing safe generic inconclusive trial reason and exact linked raw cause suffice.

Evidence-inspector tests start local HTTP listeners and are not part of this no-network reviewer plan. Root must distinguish any separate authorized existing suite execution from these fail-closed adapter calls.
remainingReleaseRequirements: If the regression proves the narrow diagnostic defect, create a separate isolated patch and keep original startup-repair files and receipts byte-identical.
Run the frozen red regression on preserved original code, then the exact same regression on patched code; preserve commands, exit codes, logs, run results and artifacts.
Verify relevant source, emitted and installed behavior plus strict type/lint/build checks for the final patch, with no assertion or fixture changes.

Actual browser baseline repeatability, full current browser acceptance, CLI demo and installed-package browser replay remain blocked/unrun until the previously identified execution capacity/prerequisite gate is legitimately resolved.

Real-capsule minimality remains unverified even after a diagnostic fix. Any new supported deletion model or adapter boundary is a new declared experiment requiring its own independently verified observations under the unchanged relevant oracle.
No publication, authentication, permission or resource-limit change is part of this task.
